messages:
maria.cheung: FYI procurement just confirmed H200 lead times for eu-west are now 20-24 weeks. we need to revisit Q3 capacity mix and reservations. @jordan @anya please weigh in

jordan: ouch. that's longer than we planned. do we have a fallback? L40S shipments are still ~6-8 weeks right?

anya: correct — L40S ETA 6-8 weeks. H100 vendor just said 10-12 weeks for us-west but limited qty. H200 is the outlier.

sam_k: quick numbers: current committed capacity = 2.4M GPU-hours/quarter (mixed). our peak forecast for Q3 is ~3.1M GPU-hours if usage growth + seasonality hit. gap ~700k hours.

olivia: should we prioritize reserving H100 for throughput-heavy customers and use L40S for embedding/light workloads? H200 seems best for latency-sensitive gen but lead time kills us.

pete: cost delta rough: H200 ~1.7x H100 list, L40S ~0.9x H100. per-token perf H200 > H100 for large context; L40S wins on price/embedding throughput.

maria.cheung: network/regional constraints: ap-south racks still constrained on power and 100Gb uplinks; can't take full H200 density there. eu-west has switch port scarcity next month. keep region placement in mind.

jordan: ops-bot inventory snapshot? can we see unallocated spare GPUs this quarter to fill that 700k gap?

ops-bot: Inventory snapshot (as-of 1774890200): unallocated = 180 GPUs (H100: 70, L40S: 90, H200: 20). projected usable hours this quarter from spare = ~360k GPU-hours (after maintenance windows).

anya: so gap reduces to ~340k hours. options: 1) accelerate additional H100 order (10-12w) and book L40S for burst, 2) buy more L40S for base and use H100 spot in cloud for latency tiers, 3) split purchase but move some demand between regions.

sam_k: pros/cons quick: (1) keeps latency profile but supply risk; (2) cheaper faster but might degrade top-tier latency SLAs under heavy load; (3) OK if networking + power allow cross-region routing.

olivia: can we quantify throughput change? crude perf numbers per GPU: H100 = 250 tokens/sec (batched workload), H200 = 420 tokens/sec, L40S = 200 tokens/sec. use these to translate hours->tokens.

pete: example calc snippet:
```
# tokens/day per GPU
H100 = 250 * 3600 * 24 = 21.6M tokens/day
H200 = 420 * 3600 * 24 = 36.3M tokens/day
L40S = 200 * 3600 * 24 = 17.28M tokens/day
```

anya: action suggestion: reserve additional 150 L40S (6-8w), 60 H100 (10-12w), postpone large H200 commit until vendor confirms earlier shipping or we lock a contract. route latency-critical customers to reserved H100 and cloud H200 burst.

maria.cheung: that split seems sensible. we need a procurement ticket with cost impact and region placement constraints. @jordan can you open ticket and include networking caveats for ap-south/eu-west?

jordan: on it. will include: lead times, cost delta, region port/power limits, and a fallback to cloud burst. ETA ticket by EOD.

sam_k: i'll update the capacity forecast spreadsheet and run scenario sims (best/likely/worst) with the new mix. will share link.

olivia: +1. also checking if we can reassign some scheduled maintenance to free up extra hours in early Q3.

pete: thumbs on contract negotiation: try to get partial shipments or staggered delivery for H200 — even a 6-week partial would help.

anya: noted. i'll ping vendor contacts tomorrow.

maria.cheung: cool. main takeaway: short-term fill with L40S + H100, delay big H200 bets until shipping certainty improves. follow-ups: jordan procurement ticket, sam capacity sims, anya vendor outreach. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: procurement ticket created -> #PR-4382 (jordan).
